notes.title: From shadows to the abyss - Join the Playtest
notes.content: [p]You may know Big Bad Wolf as the studio behind [i]Vampire: The Masquerade – Swansong[/i]: a narrative experience shaped by choices, secrets, and power plays in the dark.[/p][p]Now, the team invite you into something… deeper.[/p][p][/p][p][b][i]Cthulhu: The Cosmic Abyss[/i][/b] is a narrative-driven [b]investigation game[/b] rooted in [b]cosmic horror[/b], where perception is fragile, and truth is a dangerous thing. You’ll explore fragmented memories, decipher cultist transmissions, and survive contact with a force that predates thought itself.[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2760560/Cthulhu_The_Cosmic_Abyss/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]And the first descent begins soon.[/p][h2]Join the Playtest[/h2][p]We’re opening a [b]limited playtest[/b] to gather feedback, test systems, and share a first glimpse into the abyss. It’s free, and all you need to do is register.[/p][p][/p][h3]How to join:[/h3][p]👉 Go to the [url="https://my.nacongaming.com/en-US/playtests"]MyNacon website[/url][/p][p]👉 Create your account[/p][p]👉 Click “Register”[/p][p]If you’re selected, you will receive a NDA form to complete (All findings remain buried).[/p][p]You [b][i]must[/i] be registered before July 1st[/b]. Not all will be granted immediate entry - signals are staggered. If you receive an invitation, [b]act fast.[/b][/p][p][/p][h3]🌍 Join the Community[/h3][p][url="https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61573185434607" style="button"]Facebook[/url] [url="https://x.com/PlayCthulhuCA" style="button"]Twitter[/url] [url="https://discord.gg/Nhz2grcx39" style="button"]Discord[/url][/p]

notes.title: Nominate Us at Steam Awards!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43694095/b8114fdd670a287ff46ad276ec6b60b8154b7c04.jpg[/img]

Dear players,

The Steam Awards are here and we need your help! We need you to nominate Vampire: The Masquerade - Swansong in the [b]Best Soundtrack[/b] category!

Every voice counts, and what better way than for the community to reward the work of Olivier Derivière, the composer of the VTMS Original Soundtrack. 

Thank you for your support!
The Vampire: The Masquerade team - Swansong

[h3]Available Now On Steam:[/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1299510/Vampire_The_Masquerade__Swansong/
